gameDescriptionHtml:
Ready to soak up the sun and experience the ultimate camp adventure in a tropical paradise? Jump into the Gym Camp Simulator and transform your island into a fitness haven!

Game Features

  • Island Plan – Build new facilities, design the interior, craft camp items, and optimize resources to keep the camp running smoothly. Manage your budget wisely to expand your camp with new buildings such as a dorm, gym, dining hall, spa, infirmary, and even kindergarten for parent campers to join the camp with their children!
  • Management – Determine the right strategies to keep your guests satisfied. Make decisions to optimize the camp’s operations, such as providing excellent daily programs and activities, managing your staff effectively, and increasing your camp level and ranking. Ensure campers well-being with staff such as nurses, chefs, trainers, and more.
  • Campers – Monitor campers’ progress and adjust schedules as needed to keep them on track and happy. Create custom workout routines and meal plans to help your guests achieve their fitness goals. Campers may suffer injuries during workouts, faint from hunger, or escape from the island!
  • Events – Organize various activities to boost the mood of your campers such as yoga sessions, challenging high-energy group classes, dance parties, and gatherings around the campfire to enjoy the camp vibes. Watch out for pirates and strangers, and ensure the safety of the camp!
